description: This file defines a controller class for the OpenCart admin dashboard map functionality, including methods for displaying and saving configuration, rendering map info, and returning map data as JSON.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: Controller class for managing the dashboard map extension in OpenCart admin area, including configuration and data retrieval methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the dashboard map configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs and loading views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard map settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the view for dashboard map info, possibly including map visualization.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Provides JSON data of total orders by country for map visualization, fetched via model.
